notes.title: Patch 0.2.1r - Tournament Update
notes.notes:
[b]New Content[/b]

[b]Tournament mode[/b]
- This allows players to create a tournament room where the host is a spectator (perfect for our streamers). 
- Players can select the teams that they want to be on.
- For the host spectator, we allow a free camera using WASD movement and POV swapping using your shoot button to swap between players' POVs.

[b]Map fixes[/b]
- Resolved minor terrain issues.

[b]Controller changes[/b]
- Added aim assist
- Added aim acceleration
- Changed how the weapon wheel works on controller. Right stick is now used to determine which weapon to select

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Fixed ping only showing for host
- Fixed an issue where grenade launcher shots would explode on invisible walls
- Fixed an issue in Seal the Deal where the Madness seal wasn't properly randomizing weapon and ammo pickups
- Fixed several issues related to inputs being able to be received while the weapon wheel was open
- Fixed an issue in Seal the Deal where the Eternal seal wouldn't allow players to swap to guns that were previously out of ammo
- Fixed an issue in Seal the Deal where the Eternal seal wouldn't allow low ammo weapons to load the full magazine size
- Fixed an issue with unlocking one of the hidden skins where only one person would receive the skin instead of the entire lobby
- Slightly tweaked end of match music to end right as the match ends. Previously there was a few seconds of silence before the match actually ended
- Throwing axe should now have a different sound when hitting a player
- Fixed an issue in the lobby where changing a map, gamemode, or the lobby privacy settings would move your selected button down to start game when using a controller
- Fixed an issue where ammo pickups could be picked up when you had full ammo already
- Fixed an issue where rebinding on controllers would rebind the control, but also keep the original binding so both buttons performed the action
- Fixed an issue with rebinding where several controller controls were marked as keyboard controls, which led to players not being able to rebind those controls on controllers

[b]UI updates[/b]
- Added a message that pops up when a gun is out of ammo
- Added gun empty sound to the weapons
- Improved death cam for player ragdolls. The player will now follow the ragdoll instead of staring at the ground.
- Fixed an issue where weapon and ammo pickups wouldn't display the exact amount of ammo you received
- Weapons can now be selected on the weapon wheel using left click/A
- Changed how infinite ammo is displayed to only replace the weapons reserves with the infinity symbol
- Weapon wheel now displays infinite ammo properly

notes.title: DreadMoon Version 0.2r Update
notes.notes:
[b]New Content[/b]

[b]Game Modes[/b]
- [u]Seal the Deal[/u]: Team Deathmatch with constantly changing conditions for continual chaos.
- [u]Empowered[/u]: Team Deathmatch with only the empowered weapons.

[b]Maps[/b]
- [u]Sunken Castle[/u]: Fight for blood and honor in this flooded remnant of a castle lost to time.

[b]Skins[/b]
- Added community skin contest winner, unlocked by default.
- Added Blue, Pink, and Fox skins. Unlock methods hidden throughout the levels.

[b]Balancing[/b]
- Guns now deal equal damage to health and armor.
- Increased Pistol damage.
- Added ADS to Harpoon gun.
- Increased reload and melee animation speeds.
- Rebalanced Potions.

[b]Map Changes[/b]
- Major visual improvements to all maps.
- Significant lighting updates to all maps.
- Added new paintings, some with familiar faces!

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- Resolved issues with keybindings and headshot damage consistency.
- Fixed melee weapons displaying ammo.
- Pausing no longer preserves momentum.
- Score no longer counts up post-round.
- Fixed “AlreadyRunning” Error.
- Potions no longer explode on invisible walls or bounce.
- Corrected functionality of Blessed potion.
- Updated Acid potion visuals.
- Potion visuals now consistent regardless of camera position.
- Volume sliders fully mute at 0.
- Vsync, FPS, and sensitivity settings persist across matches.
- Fixed Winchester ADS persistence.
- Resolved invisible gun pickups post-pickup.
- Joining Alpha matches no longer misassigns teams.
- Fixed lobby display of “all armor” on characters.
- Consistent display of Steam icon and profile name in lobbies.
- Aligned Alpha attack SFX with animation.

[b]Functionality Changes[/b]
- Invite friends from Steam friends list.
- Lobby hosts can kick players.
- Join games via Steam Friends List.

[b]UI[/b]
- Adjusted UI text sizes.
- Updated Cranked countdown timer for clarity.
- Centered specific text instances.
- Adjusted weapon wheel colors.
- Updated scoreboard to not cover pause menu; viewable when dead.
- Updated character customization icons.
- Added FPS Counter.
- Updated match result text.
- Revised grenade reticle.
- Adjusted crosshair sizes.
- Clarified dash icon recharge.
- Updated empowered weapon pickup icon.

[b]Visual Changes[/b]
- Improved Dash Visual Effect.
- Axe throwable now embeds on impact.
- Empowered weapons now have a golden shine.

notes.title: DreadMoon Holiday Update - Performance Boosts and Gameplay Tweaks!
notes.notes:
[b]Happy Holidays, DreadMoon Community![/b]


We're thrilled to announce the release of our latest DreadMoon update, just in time for the holiday season. This update focuses on enhancing performance and fine-tuning gameplay for an even more thrilling experience. Check out the highlights:

---

[b]Key Updates:[/b]

- [b]Server Stability:[/b] Numerous fixes to ensure smoother, more stable gameplay.
- [b]Rendering Pipeline:[/b] Upgraded for optimized performance.
- [b]Weapon Balancing:[/b] Several adjustments for a more balanced combat experience.
- [b]Map Enhancements:[/b] Fixes and tweaks to improve overall performance and gameplay.
- [b]Movement: [/b]Enhanced fluidity and responsiveness in-game.

---

[b]Detailed Weapon Adjustments:[/b]

- [b]General:[/b]  - Movement speed decreased while carrying flag.
  - Blood raged players can't pick up empowered weapons.
- [b]Crossbow:[/b]
  - Increased fire rate.
- [b]Grenade Launcher:[/b]
  - Damage and force output increased.
- [b]Minigun:[/b]
  - Recoil and spread reduced, with improved hit detection.
- [b]Pistol:[/b]
  - Increased headshot damage.
- [b]Shotgun:[/b]
  - Adjusted damage fall-off and reduced damage.
  - Reserve ammo now limited to 8.
- [b]Empowered Weapons:[/b]
  - Various tweaks including ammo adjustments and damage enhancements.

---

[b]Map Specific Fixes:[/b]

- [b]Library:[/b] Performance improvements.
- [b]Mausoleum: [/b]Geometry fixes to prevent wall, stair, and pillar exploits.
- [b]Church: [/b]Collider fixes around trees and walls.
- [b]Town:[/b] Adjusted colliders for enhanced interaction.

---

[b]Additional Features:[/b]

- [b][/b]Achievements: Now visible in-game.
- Grenades can no longer pass through walls.
- Restrictions on flag pickup during certain animations.
- [b]Announcer Voice Lines: [/b]Limited continuous updates.
- [b]Input Changes:[/b] Enhanced for smoother movement.

---

We've spent a lot of time ensuring that we can address as many performance issues as possible! We hope you all enjoy some of these changes before the holiday season! We're dedicated to continually improving DreadMoon, and your feedback is invaluable. Enjoy the update and happy hunting! 

---

notes.title: Patch Notes for Build 0.1.1r Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Happy DreadMoon release day!

It’s been a great first day and we appreciate everyone who has taken some time today to play the game! We are aware of the performance issues some of you have experienced today, and we’re working towards fixes. Thank you all for being patient with us as we address them, and if you come across any additional bugs you would like to make us aware of, please send them in the “report a problem” channel on our Discord server. 

The following fixes have been made today and we’ll continue addressing stability issues this week.

Day 1 patch notes:
Occlusion culling added for each multiplayer map. This will help with performance while we work on other optimization fixes.
Private lobbies fixed
Armor bar properly updates after dying and respawning

Again, thank you to everyone who has played DreadMoon so far! As a reminder we will be rolling out our custom skin design competition this week and Steam deck giveaways next week, so stay tuned for more details.
